python3 -c 'from pathlib import Path
import re
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
p=Path("pelican.svg")
root=ET.fromstring(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
assert root.tag == "{http://www.w3.org/2000/svg}svg", "expected SVG namespace/root"
for e in root.iter():
    tag=e.tag.rsplit("}",1)[-1].lower()
    assert tag not in {"script","image","foreignobject"}, "standalone vector content required"
    for key,value in e.attrib.items():
        local=key.rsplit("}",1)[-1].lower()
        assert not local.startswith("on"), "event handlers are not allowed"
        if local == "href":
            assert value.strip().startswith("#"), "external references are not allowed"
        for target in re.findall(r"url\(([^)]*)\)", value, re.I):
            assert target.strip(" \"'"'"'\t\r\n").startswith("#"), "external CSS resources are not allowed"
    if tag == "style":
        text=e.text or ""
        assert "@import" not in text.lower(), "external styles are not allowed"
        for target in re.findall(r"url\(([^)]*)\)", text, re.I):
            assert target.strip(" \"'"'"'\t\r\n").startswith("#"), "external CSS resources are not allowed"
print("SVG_XML_SELF_CONTAINED_OK")
'
